# CHAPTER 1: Core Methodologies

## 1.1 Fan-Filter-Scale Methodology
URL: https://alim.dest.page/blog/fan-filter-scale-methodology

The Fan-Filter-Scale framework is a systematic 3-stage engine for building high-leverage AI-native products:
1. **Fan (Divergence)**: Expand hypotheses rapidly using AI generative capacity across multiple vectors without premature optimization.
2. **Filter (Validation & Selection)**: Subject all raw signals to brutal friction filters, customer problem validation (The Mom Test), ICE scoring, and architectural feasibility checks.
3. **Scale (Autonomous Systematization)**: Convert approved concepts into repeatable agent skills, self-healing code loops, and automated deployment pipelines.

## 1.2 Loop Engineering for LLM Agents
URL: https://alim.dest.page/blog/loop-engineering-autonomous-llm-agents

Single-prompt generation fails in complex production workflows. Loop Engineering structures AI behavior into discrete feedback loops:
- **Thought**: Formulate reasoning, plan steps, and define acceptance criteria before taking action.
- **Action**: Execute focused tool calls (code edits, file reads, test runs).
- **Observation**: Read environment output, lint feedback, and test execution results.
- **Self-Correction**: Iteratively resolve discrepancies until the Definition of Done is fully met.

## 1.3 Living Agent Harness & Project Memory Engine
URL: https://alim.dest.page/wiki/end

Context is volatile during extended coding sessions. The Living Agent Harness solves recency bias and context loss via structured tiers:
- `.agents/agents.md`: Master manifest, agent roles, and active routing table.
- `.agents/wiki/user_intent.md`: Cumulative living user intent matrix permanently recording all user decisions.
- `.agents/wiki/architecture.md`: Project architecture and structural invariants.
- `.agents/facts/`: Immutable domain facts and environmental constraints.

# CHAPTER 2: Showcase Projects & Agent Skills

## 2.1 /wiki — AI-Wiki Knowledge Compiler
URL: https://alim.dest.page/projects/wiki
Command: `/wiki`

### Overview
Automatically discovers real project files, categorizes knowledge into Public & Private 2-Tier meta-layers, and renders hyper-minimalist documentation portals with zero boilerplate.

### Workflow Lifecycle
1. **Scan Project Files**: Reads markdown docs from all folders, extracts headings, summaries, and tags while keeping document hierarchy intact.
2. **Smart Categorization**: Splits public articles from private memory, removes redundant boilerplate, and calculates reading times.
3. **Minimalist Portal**: Renders clean, distraction-free cards with high-contrast typography and instant category navigation.
4. **Instant Search**: Sub-millisecond keyword matching with direct anchor links and quick sharing.

---

## 2.2 /presentation — Strategic Deck & Motion Storytelling Studio
URL: https://alim.dest.page/projects/presentation
Command: `/presentation`

### Overview
Creates high-impact, motion-driven HTML presentation decks based on the 10 Communication Vectors, with Jakub/Emil micro-animations, keyboard navigation, and speaker script teleprompter.

### Core Principles
- Strict 'One Idea = One Slide' rule across all presentations.
- Zero wall-of-text bullets: maximum 3 concise points per card.
- Standalone code: runs directly in any browser without external software.
- Built-in presenter notes accessible with the [S] hotkey.

---

## 2.3 /skill-visualizer — 16:9 Vector Flowchart & Architecture Engine
URL: https://alim.dest.page/projects/skill-visualizer
Command: `/skill-visualizer`

### Overview
Creates crystal-clear, full-screen 16:9 vector flowcharts tailored specifically to any agent workflow.

### Architectural Invariants
- Strict 16:9 aspect ratio across all screen sizes (1600x900 coordinate system).
- Solid pod containers (`rx="24"`) with calibrated dark tinted backgrounds (`#131d2e`, `#201533`, `#2a1d0d`, `#0d2b1d`).
- Unified single-line headers sharing exact font size (`23px bold`).
- Zero void space: card heights wrap text tightly without giant empty boxes.

---

## 2.4 /styleref — Generative Visual Styles & Prompt DB
URL: https://alim.dest.page/projects/styleref
Command: `/styleref`

### Overview
A curated gallery of 19 unique visual art styles (Jakub Różalski, Simon Stålenhag, Beksiński, Blue Eye Samurai, and more) with one-click prompt copying and lighting parameters.

## 2.5 /design-md-generator — DESIGN.md Architecture Generator
URL: https://alim.dest.page/projects/design-md-generator
Command: `/design-md-generator`

### Overview
Creates standardized DESIGN.md specification files. Defines your color palettes in OKLCH, typography scales, spacing tokens, and component guidelines for both humans and AI agents. Fully conforms to the google-labs-code/design.md standard.

---

## 2.6 /end — End-of-Session Ritual & Memory Keeper
URL: https://alim.dest.page/projects/end
Command: `/end`

### Overview
A comprehensive end-of-session ritual for AI coding assistants. Audits completed tasks, saves memory into .agents/, stops dangling dev servers, and commits code safely with verified author email.
